notes:
QC notes / negotiation fragments:
- Use-case: low-latency trading assistant + risk-scorer; critical at market open for 2x daily traffic spikes.
- Customer requests explicit throughput guarantee: minimum 45,000 tokens/sec cluster-wide sustained for trading workload, 99th pct tail latency < 200ms for single-turn prompts (<=512 tokens).
- Concurrency cap ask: allow up to 120 concurrent chat sessions with soft caps; prefer per-route concurrency controls so non-critical rerank jobs do not evict trading inference.
- Burst policy request: burst allowance to 2x baseline for 3 minutes at market open and during earnings; wants predictable burst budget (tokens/min) and a transparent throttling policy when exceeded.
- Reserve GPU planning: POC measured ~5.6k tokens/sec per A100-equivalent for mixed-length workload; baseline sizing proposal = 8 reserved GPUs for steady-state + 4 burst-only GPUs (warm standby) to meet 45k sustained and 2x burst. SE calc attached in drive doc.
- Autoscale behavior: customer asked for predictable autoscale delay (max 20s) and explicit warm-warmup on reserved burst nodes to avoid cold-KV misses.
- Fallbacks & graceful degradation: prefer model routing fallback to a quantized variant (lower cost) under sustained overload, preserving core latency SLO for trading prompts.
- SLO credit model: customer pushing for financial credits if tokens/sec guarantee not met for >5 minutes in a billing window; suggested SLA tiers and penalty caps discussed.
- Security: require VPC peering, customer KMS, audit logging export to their SIEM, and quarterly SOC2 evidence.
- Pricing sensitivity: total ARR target must stay under $2M; tradeoffs between reserved vs burst-on-demand explained.
- Quote from CTO: "We need guarantees at market open — unpredictable throttles are unacceptable."
- Next technical ask: formal appendix with guaranteed min tokens/sec, concurrency policy language, burst budget wording, and an agreed test harness for acceptance.
- Stubs/links: pricing draft, security FAQ, POC logs present in drive.
